latestVersion.changelog:
Weather Character Skill 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Generates unique weather-themed character images using your mood, real-time weather, and choice of 27 Chinese cities.
- Supports interactive dialogs for mood and city selection.
- Maintains character consistency; allows custom character image replacement.
- Runs daily at 7:30 AM with easy setup and scheduling.
